title: Weighted Homology and Cohomology of Weighted Polyhedra
summary: We define the notion of weighted polyhedron which can be thought of as the geometric realization of a weighted simplicial complex introduced by Dawson. Moreover, we will define a weighted version of singular homology theory for a weighted polyhedron and prove that it is isomorphic to the weighted simplicial homology of the weighted polyhedron. This implies that weighted simplicial homology is an invariant under isomorphisms and more generally under certain type of homotopy equivalences of weighted polyhedra.
